==Hungarian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|hu|kompjuter|kompjúter||see Usage notes}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|hu|:bor|en:computer|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{hu-IPA|kompjúter|kompjuter|komputer}}<ref>{{R:GretsyKemeny 2005}}</ref> {{q|the latter is rare}}
* {{hyphenation|hu|kom|pu|ter}}
* {{rhyme|hu|ɛr|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{hu-noun|ek}}

# {{lb|hu|dated}} {{synonym of|hu|számítógép||[[computer]]|pos=a programmable device}}

====Usage notes====
This spelling is the officially endorsed, accepted version,<ref>{{R:MHSz 2017}}</ref> although hybrid<ref>[https://www.nyest.hu/hirek/computer-kompjuter-vagy-komputer Computer, kompjúter vagy komputer? Furcsa hibrid a „komputer”, mégis helyes…] “''Computer, kompjúter'' or ''komputer''? ‘Computer’ is a strange hybrid, yet correct…” (Nyest.hu, 2014)</ref><ref>[http://real-j.mtak.hu/6052/1/MagyarNyelvor_1978.pdf Süle, Jenő. Idegen szavaink nyelvhasználatunkban, ahogy ma látjuk]
“Foreign words in our linguistic usage, as we see it today” (''Magyar Nyelvőr,'' vol.&nbsp;102, issue&nbsp;1, 1978, pp.&nbsp;8–26)</ref> in terms of reflecting the pronunciation of “c” as [k] but preserving the English spelling of “u” despite its approximate pronunciations [ju] or [juː]. Its alternative forms {{m|hu||kompjuter}} or {{m|hu||kompjúter}}, though more faithful in pronunciation and consistent in transcription, are considered nonstandard. The term is dated in any versions, nonetheless.

The standard version was possibly chosen because the {{nowrap|''p + j'' + vowel}} sequence is uncommon within a Hungarian word stem (cf. {{m|hu|musical}} as a Hungarian loanword rather than {{m|hu||*mjuzikel}}).<ref>{{R:OsirisHelyes 2006}}, pp. 242–244.</ref> The [j] between a vowel and a consonant is more accepted in loanwords, e.g. {{m|hu|[[lájk]][[lájkol|(ol)]]}}, {{m|hu|fájl}}, {{m|hu|szmájli}}, and the considerably earlier {{m|hu|sztrájk}}. It is also possible that eliminating the sound [j] seemed preferable when codifying the form so [komputer] was in fact meant to reflect the Hungarian pronunciation.<ref>[https://frissmedia.hu/hir/tudja-hogy-kell-irni-az-idegen-szavakat-magyarul/13446 Tudja, hogy kell írni az idegen szavakat – magyarul?] “Do you know how to write foreign words – in Hungarian?” (Frissmédia)</ref>
